metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
Detects Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) sensors on servers that either 
- Were previously active but have stopped reporting for at least threshold_hours.
- Never reported as active during the lookback period.
properties.query:
// Service Ticket #4339732 - SOCe | Rules for mde agents health monitoring
let ExcludedServers = (_GetWatchlist("Excluded_Servers") |extend server_name = column_ifexists('server_name',"") |distinct server_name |project SearchKey = (server_name)); //Added to exclude known servers
let lookback = 14d;
let threshold_hours = 24; // for at least how many hours the agent must have gone inactive
let TenantIdTable = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true
        (ThreatIntelIndicators | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | where isnotempty(AzureTenantId)  | take 1 | project TenantId = AzureTenantId),
        (OfficeActivity        | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | where isnotempty(OrganizationId) | take 1 | project TenantId = OrganizationId),
        (SigninLogs            | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | where isnotempty(AADTenantId)    | take 1 | project TenantId = AADTenantId)
    | take 1
);
let tid = coalesce(toscalar(TenantIdTable | project TenantId), "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000");
let FilteredDevices = materialize(
  DeviceInfo 
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) 
  | where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
  | where DeviceType == "Server"
  | project DeviceName, DeviceId, TimeGenerated, Timestamp, tostring(SensorHealthState)
);
let NeverActiveDevice = FilteredDevices
| summarize make_set(SensorHealthState,10) by DeviceId
| where not(set_has_element(set_SensorHealthState, "Active"))
| lookup kind=inner FilteredDevices on DeviceId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| extend HoursSinceLastActive = -1;
let PreviousActiveDevices = FilteredDevices
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| join kind=inner (
  FilteredDevices
  | where SensorHealthState == "Active"
  | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
  | project DeviceId, TimeGeneratedWhenLastActive = TimeGenerated, TimestampWhenLastActive = Timestamp
) on DeviceId
| where SensorHealthState != "Active" and TimeGenerated > TimeGeneratedWhenLastActive
| extend HoursSinceLastActive = datetime_diff('hour', now(), TimeGeneratedWhenLastActive)
| where HoursSinceLastActive > threshold_hours;
union PreviousActiveDevices, NeverActiveDevice
| extend SinceLastActiveDescription = iff(HoursSinceLastActive >= 0, strcat("Hours since last active: ", tostring(HoursSinceLastActive)), strcat("Never Active in ", toint(lookback/1d), " days"))
| project DeviceId, DeviceName, SensorHealthState, HoursSinceLastActive, SinceLastActiveDescription, TimeGenerated, TimeGeneratedWhenLastActive, TimestampWhenLastActive
| where DeviceName !in (ExcludedServers)
| extend MDEDeviceLink = strcat("https://security.microsoft.com/machines/", DeviceId, "?tid=", tid)

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: MDE Sensor on {{DeviceName}} is in state: {{SensorHealthState}} - {{SinceLastActiveDescription}}
